selection: Explicit --variant plus a written reason; no score-based auto-selection.

source_binding.runtime: All src/**/*.py plus scripts/train_sequence.py, hashed at init and rechecked before every command.
source_binding.packet: All static files in high_compute_r4/, excluding Python caches and runtime outputs.
source_binding.R3: Frozen large_teacher_r3_muon30 recipe and four source configs are separately hash-bound.

split_contract.inner_fit: Complete source-qualified fitting membership after component-disjoint validation is reserved from the outer fitting pool.
split_contract.inner_evaluation: Reserved component-disjoint validation from the outer fitting pool; development evidence only.
split_contract.outer_evaluation: F0/F2 are already exposed. G and H are robustness/transfer evidence, not untouched generalization.

A.status: Frozen R3 first capacity panel; already planned and not materialized by R4.

conditional_route.interpretation: Nominal route assumes candidate differs from the R3 reference in G and every exact reuse contract passes.

accounting.cost_units: Fit counts and epochs are not GPU-hour estimates. Failed attempts are retained and counted separately; profiles, exports, cache parity, merges and packaging are additional engineering work.

teacher_recipe.optimizer: Muon with AdamW-matched RMS convention; auxiliary AdamW beta=(0.9,0.95), eps=1e-8.
teacher_recipe.precision_contract: BF16 autocast for model forward plus the process-wide cuBLAS single-precision emulation request; parameters, gradients, optimizer state, and loss remain FP32. The mode requires CUBLAS_EMULATE_SINGLE_PRECISION=1 and may also affect Muon operations.
teacher_recipe.profile_peak: Only warmup_fraction changes to 0.0; weights are engineering evidence and must not be consumed as endpoints.

C.question: Warmup after selecting B learning rate.
C.exact_reuse: Two selected-LR 5% warmup endpoints from B.

D.question: Forward attention context; gradient horizon stays 512 rows.

E.question: Combined chunk and backward-horizon recipe at selected context.
E.exact_reuse: Two selected chunk512/accumulation8 endpoints from D.

G.question: Three paired seeds on both exposed outer folds: frozen F candidate versus an R3-hyperparameter 1.54B reference using the same R4 BF16_BF16x9 precision/runtime flags.
G.alias_rule: If candidate config equals the R4-policy-matched reference after removing only expected_fold and seed, candidate reuses the same reference IDs and paths; only six unique fits are declared.

H.question: Raw112 GRU512x2 transfer with matched labels, single-teacher KD and equal mean of three selected-recipe G caches.
H.student_recipe: 30 epochs, BF16_BF16x9 precision mode, AdamW lr=3e-4 beta=(0.9,0.95), eps=1e-8, warmup=0.05 cosine floor=0.1, weight_decay=0.01, clip=1.0, dropout=0, chunk_rows=512, accumulation=8, per-rank batch=2, world_size=8, all-fit normalization, all-after-warmup labels, hint_dim=0, KD weight=0 for labels and 1 for both KD arms.
H.single_teacher: Candidate cache for seed 301001, frozen before any G outer score is read; use that G run's teacher-cache directly.
H.mean_teacher: Equal mean of candidate caches for seeds 301001, 301002 and 301003, within the same fold.

cache_targets.single: the first frozen G candidate run's teacher-cache (no copy or merge)

r3_reference.G_reference_configs: The frozen t1792_f0.json and t1792_f2.json hyperparameter recipes with G fold/seed identity and the same BF16_BF16x9, efficient-attention, compiled-block, no-checkpointing policy as the candidate. The frozen R3 source configs are not edited.

execution_boundary: prepare writes manifests and complete configs only. It never queues, launches, retries, or selects fits. Root-owned run.sh/dispatch and receiving-host admission remain separate gates.
